title: Hurry Up
question: How do you know Sam doesn't make the tea very often?

meanings.usage: 常与up连用，表示催促某人快点
烧水用的容器，常用于泡茶
盛放茶叶并泡茶的容器
存放餐具和食物的家具
表示位置，在某物的背面
表示位置，在某物的前方
水加热到100度的过程，用于泡茶
用于肯定句中修饰可数或不可数名词
用于疑问句和否定句中
表示位置，与be动词连用表示存在

examples.en: Hurry up, Sam! The kettle's boiling!

phrases.usage: 询问某人是否能够做某事

examples.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?
Is there any water in this kettle?
Where's the tea?
There it is! It's in front of you!
It's over there, behind the teapot.

phrases.usage: 肯定地回答，表示当然可以

examples.en: Yes, of course I can, Penny.

phrases.usage: 询问对方是否能看见某物

examples.en: Can you see it?

phrases.phrase: There are some in the cupboard

examples.en: There are some in the cupboard.
It's behind the teapot.

sentences.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can, Penny.
Is there any water in this kettle?
It's over there, behind the teapot.
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
sentences.zh: 我能看到茶壶，但我看不到茶。

sentences.en: Ah yes, I can see it now.
There are some in the cupboard.

source.en: Yes, of course I can, Penny.

exercises.prompt: “用there is/there are来表示某处存在某物” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: There is + 单数名词/不可数名词 + 地点; There are + 复数名词 + 地点
options: 一般将来时 (Future Simple Tense - will)
There is/There are 表示存在
频率副词在一般现在时中的位置
exercises.explain: There is/There are 表示存在：There is + 单数名词/不可数名词 + 地点; There are + 复数名词 + 地点：用于描述某处有什么东西，some用于肯定句，any用于疑问句和否定句

source.title: There is/There are 表示存在

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

grammar.title: Can表示能力 (Can for Ability)
grammar.definition: can用于表达某人做某事的能力或可能性
grammar.structure: Can + 主语 + 动词原形?
grammar.usage: 用于询问或陈述某人是否会做某事，否定形式为cannot或can't

examples.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?
Yes, of course I can.
I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.
examples.zh: 我能看见茶壶，但看不见茶叶。

grammar.title: There is/There are 表示存在
grammar.definition: 用there is/there are来表示某处存在某物
grammar.structure: There is + 单数名词/不可数名词 + 地点; There are + 复数名词 + 地点
grammar.usage: 用于描述某处有什么东西，some用于肯定句，any用于疑问句和否定句

examples.en: Is there any water in this kettle?
Yes, there is.
There are some in the cupboard.

grammar.title: 方位介词 (Prepositions of Place)
grammar.definition: 表示位置关系的介词或介词短语
grammar.structure: behind/in front of/over there + 名词
grammar.usage: behind表示在后面，in front of表示在前面，over there表示在那边

examples.en: It's over there, behind the teapot.
It's in front of you!

original.en: Can you make the tea, Sam?

examples.en: Can you find them?
Can you see it?

patterns.pattern: Is there any + 不可数名词/可数名词复数?

original.en: Is there any water in this kettle?

examples.en: Is there any tea in the pot?
Is there any milk in the fridge?
Where are the cups?
Where is my book?

patterns.pattern: There is/are + 主语 + 地点

original.en: There are some in the cupboard.

examples.en: There is a cup on the table.
There are some books on the shelf.
